source.description: Grok-first defaults. Each agent maps to the best Grok model for its role, with GPT equivalent as fallback.

equivalents._comment: GPT -> Grok equivalent mapping for reference

perf_notes.grok-3-mini-fast: Fastest Grok: 1.96s coding, 146t/s. Best for high-volume read-only agents (explorer).
perf_notes.grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning: Fast reasoning-capable: 0.68s coding, 1.96s reasoning. Best for analysis/review.
perf_notes.grok-4.20-0309-reasoning: Deep reasoning: 6.3s, 163t/s. Best for planning, complex analysis.
perf_notes.grok-4.3: Frontier: 8.48s, 159t/s. Best for deep verification, complex multi-step.
perf_notes.grok-build-0.1: Build agent: 3.72s, 150t/s. Good for coding tasks.

librarian.role_rationale: External research needs fast reliable model (LazyCodex 4.10.0)

plan.role_rationale: Strategic planning needs deep frontier reasoning (LazyCodex 4.10.0)

metis.role_rationale: Pre-planning contradiction detection with frontier model (LazyCodex 4.10.0)

momus.role_rationale: Plan review needs frontier reasoning and edge-case detection (LazyCodex 4.10.0)

codex-ultrawork-reviewer.role_rationale: Final verification needs frontier model depth (LazyCodex 4.10.0)

coding.role_rationale: Coding role: fast Grok non-reasoning path (LazyCodex 4.10.0)

default.role_rationale: Default execution agent (LFP Hephaestus analogue on Grok)

ulw.role_rationale: Ultrawork orchestrator (LFP Sisyphus analogue on Grok)
